doctrine: ORACLE_DOCTRINE.md §5 (P2-lock): zero misses in covered classes (sqli, xss, auth-bypass, idor, exposure).
semantics: bar items are in-envelope (black-box HTTP, unauth or operator session) and suite-enforced at recall 1.0. named-miss items are IN-CLASS plants outside the envelope (browser/2-account/CSRF walls) — reported red, never silent. bare = no plant on that bench. uncovered = outside the 5 classes. Fixing a wall moves its items to bar; nothing moves off bar without a doctrine change.

items.evidence: ?id=%27&Submit=Submit returns 200 + 'You have an error in your SQL syntax'. Two gates: the query requires the form's Submit field (low.php isset gate) AND an unbalanced quote (tautologies are valid SQL returning rows). Found via harvest-form reframe (bare-quote error trigger through the page's own form). TRAP: the footer contains 'SQLi DB: mysql', so generic-marker confirms without the true error text are false positives (mapping asserts the error text). The errorprobe expects the strict marker subset (SQLI_ERROR_MARKERS, no bare 'mysql') so teardown's 9-fill control rejects footer-only output and true errors survive. E2E needs authed recon (P14: cookie to katana + crawl bridge) + emission budget for crawled pages.

named.evidence: authbypass/get_user_data.php returns all users to any LOGGED-IN user at low (admin-only at high/impossible). Proving the bypass needs a NON-admin session vs admin session differential — two accounts. No single-session auth bypass exists in any low module.

PROBED: bac low ?action=view&user_id=2 without user_id cookie returns 'Access denied. No user_id cookie found'. Cross-user read needs forging Cookie user_id=N to match ?user_id=N — the envelope never mints cookies.
weak_id low POST sets sequential dvwaSession cookie (session prediction, CWE-384/330) — session management, not one of the 5 covered classes. Named, not missed.
sqli_blind needs boolean/time-based inference loops. The envelope has no timing differential and no multi-request inference — single-shot error/reflection probes only.

PROBED live: POST txtName+mtxMessage+btnSign (no CSRF at low) stores <script>, re-GET renders it unescaped — REAL but two-step (form-POST then re-GET). Envelope persist probes POST JSON expecting 201-echo (oracle_seam_templates _t_xss_reflect), never form-store + re-GET.

javascript low is client-side token logic (md5(rot13(phrase)) in page JS) — client-side auth logic needing JS execution, outside the 5 classes. Named, not missed.
Command injection, file upload, file inclusion, CSRF, open redirect, CSP, cryptography modules are outside the 5 covered classes (same UNCOVERED treatment as P2 open-redirect). Named, not missed.

URL inventory (introduction/urls.py, 123 routes) shows NO per-user object endpoint: ssti/blog/<id> renders a template path (SSTI, out-of-class), mitre/9/lab/api/<recipent>/<amount> is an action, broken_access_lab3_secret enforces login with no object reference. No IDOR plant exists.
xss_lab2 strips <script> (bypass needs event-handler/encoding craft), xss_lab3 strips alphanumerics (JSFuck-style only). Both POST-only + CSRF. Envelope reflection probes are verbatim-tag GETs.

ba_lab / broken_access_lab_1 need Cookie admin=1 with POST creds (cookie minting); lab_2 needs magic UA 'pygoat_admin' (bench-specific value); lab_3/lab3_secret need two-role differential. All outside single-shot header probing.
OTP lab: GET email -> 3-digit OTP -> POST otp + email cookie. Brute-forcing 100-999 over HTTP with cookie jar is a flow attack, not a single-shot probe.
PROBED: /get_version discloses 'pyyaml v5.1' unauth — a single version string. Below the exposure bar (version-only signals FP on every footer); inventoried, not barred.
SSTI, XXE, command injection, insecure deserialization, SSRF, crypto-failure labs are outside the 5 covered classes. Named, not missed.
